# UX and Interaction Requirements Checklist: Worktime of Another User

**Purpose**: Test whether the requirements for what the user sees and does (name in the header, launcher, person choice in the settings, name check, list of people, alert, return to the signed-in user) are complete, clear, consistent, and measurable before tasks are generated
**Created**: 2026-11-13
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) (with [plan.md](../plan.md), [data-model.md](../data-model.md), and [contracts/ui.md](../contracts/ui.md) as supporting context)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

**Scope chosen (defaults, no extra input was given)**: depth Standard; audience: the spec author, before `/speckit-tasks`; focus: display and interaction requirements, and the rules of the name check. The same choice as for `ux.md` of 001.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 - Is it specified what the table shows between a change of person and the arrival of the new person's data (emptied, or the previous person's rows under the spinner)? [Gap, Spec §FR-003, §FR-004] → Resolved in spec: FR-003: emptied at once.
- [x] CHK002 - Is it specified what the launcher shows for another person while their first load is running or has failed (name with no total, or the previous value)? [Gap, Spec §FR-033] → Resolved in spec: FR-041.
- [x] CHK003 - Is the order of the people in the list specified, and which 10 are shown when more than 10 match? [Gap, Spec §FR-030] → Resolved in spec: FR-030.
- [x] CHK004 - Is it specified what a list entry shows for a person whose e-mail address is not visible? [Gap, Spec §FR-030] → Resolved in spec: FR-030.
- [x] CHK005 - Is it specified where the keyboard focus goes after the list appears and after a person is picked from it? [Gap, Spec §FR-031] → Resolved in spec: FR-030, FR-031.
- [x] CHK006 - Is it specified whether Enter in the name field acts as "Zapisz"? [Gap, Spec §FR-016] → Resolved in spec: FR-042.
- [x] CHK007 - Are limits of the name field specified (longest text, shortest text that is checked, allowed characters)? [Gap, Spec §FR-012, §FR-018] → Resolved in spec: FR-012, FR-018.
- [x] CHK008 - Is it specified how long a name check may run before it counts as failed, or is a check without a time limit intended? [Gap, Spec §FR-019, §FR-023] → Resolved in spec: FR-045.
- [x] CHK009 - Is it specified whether the person still changes when the check succeeds but the browser cannot store the settings? [Gap, Spec §FR-024, §FR-035] → Resolved in spec: FR-024.
- [x] CHK010 - Is it specified what the name line shows when Jira gives no name for the signed-in user? [Gap, Spec §FR-006, §FR-010] → Resolved in spec: FR-010.
- [x] CHK011 - Are the exact Polish texts of the alert, the field messages, the field label, and the list lines part of the requirements, or only of the design contract? [Completeness, Spec §FR-029, Contract ui.md] → Resolved in spec: FR-029: the texts are in the spec.
- [x] CHK012 - Is a click outside the settings specified for the time the alert window is shown (ignored, closes the alert, or closes everything)? [Gap, Spec §FR-020] → Resolved in spec: FR-020, FR-047.
- [x] CHK013 - Is the state of "Cofnij" and "Ponów" after a change of person stated in this spec, or only implied by "forgotten"? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004] → Resolved in spec: FR-004.

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK014 - Is "a distinct colour" defined with observable properties (which colour, what it must differ from, the contrast it must reach)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007] → Resolved in spec: FR-007.
- [x] CHK015 - Is "at most about 24 characters" on the launcher precise enough to be checked, or does "about" need a firm rule? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-034] → Resolved in spec: FR-034: the width of 24 characters.
- [x] CHK016 - Is "show that work is in progress" defined for the name check (what changes, on which control)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-019] → Resolved in spec: FR-019.
- [x] CHK017 - Is "a small window ... on top of the settings" defined enough to be checked (what it covers, where it stands)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-020] → Resolved in spec: FR-020.
- [x] CHK018 - Is the matching rule deterministic enough to write acceptance cases, given that "a text from the middle of a word may find nobody"? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-017] → Resolved in spec: FR-017.
- [x] CHK019 - Is it clear what happens when the typed text equals one person's full name while another person's longer name also contains it (the list, or that person at once)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-026, Plan §Open points D4] → Resolved in spec: FR-026, US3 scenario 11.
- [x] CHK020 - Is it clear which text the name field holds when the user switches between the two options more than once: the text typed in this visit or the remembered person's name? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-012, §FR-036] → Resolved in spec: FR-013.
- [x] CHK021 - Is it clear whether typing one's own name stores oneself as the remembered person? [Clarity, Spec §FR-035, Edge Cases] → Resolved in spec: FR-035, Edge Cases.
- [x] CHK022 - Are "first and last name", "full name", and "name as Jira has it" used for one and the same thing throughout, and is that thing defined once? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, Assumptions] → Resolved in spec: Terms.

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK023 - Does "with the usual loading state" (which in 001 keeps the old rows on screen) agree with the rule that the previous person's data is never under the new name? [Conflict, Spec §FR-003, §FR-004, §SC-002, 001 §FR-060] → Resolved in spec: FR-003 names 001 FR-060 and sets it aside.
- [x] CHK024 - Does "each with what tells them apart" in the scenario of two people of the same name agree with a list that shows only an e-mail address that may be hidden? [Consistency, Spec §US3 scenario 7, §FR-030] → Resolved in spec: US3 scenario 7, FR-030.
- [x] CHK025 - Is the order of Escape consistent across the alert, the settings, and the panel, and is it stated in the spec and not only in the design contract? [Consistency, Spec §FR-020, 001 §FR-041, §FR-064] → Resolved in spec: FR-047.
- [x] CHK026 - Does "none of the settings changed in this visit take effect" agree with the appearance preview that stays visible while the settings remain open? [Consistency, Spec §FR-021, Assumptions, 001 §FR-046] → Resolved in spec: FR-021.
- [x] CHK027 - Do the colour rules of the launcher in 001 (value and dot) and the new name colour describe one consistent launcher for a single day, a longer period, and a zero total? [Consistency, Spec §FR-033, 001 §FR-040, §FR-068] → Resolved in spec: FR-033.
- [x] CHK028 - Are the numbers of actions in SC-001 consistent with the steps the user stories describe? [Consistency, Spec §SC-001, §US2, §US3] → Resolved in spec: SC-001.

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK029 - Can "the two never disagree, also while data is loading" be verified objectively, with the moments of observation named? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002] → Resolved in spec: SC-002.
- [x] CHK030 - Can "tell whose time is on screen within 2 seconds" be verified without a user study, or is a proxy criterion defined? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006] → Resolved in spec: SC-006.
- [x] CHK031 - Are the conditions stated under which the time limits of SC-001 and SC-004 hold (amount of data, state of the connection)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, §SC-004] → Resolved in spec: SC-001, SC-004.
- [x] CHK032 - Does every functional requirement from FR-030 to FR-036, added after the clarifications, have an acceptance scenario that covers it? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §FR-030 to §FR-036] → Resolved in spec: US2 scenarios 14 to 16, US3 scenarios 10 to 13, US4 scenarios 7 to 9.

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK033 - Is the direct change from one other person to a second other person covered by a requirement or a scenario? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §US2] → Resolved in spec: US2 scenario 12, FR-049.
- [x] CHK034 - Is the recovery path after "the user could not be checked" specified (what the user can do next, and what stays on screen)? [Coverage, Recovery, Spec §FR-023] → Resolved in spec: FR-023, US3 scenario 6.
- [x] CHK035 - Are keyboard-only and touch flows through the options, the field, the list, and the alert covered by scenarios, or only by the general requirement? [Coverage, Spec §FR-015, §FR-030] → Resolved in spec: US2 scenario 16, FR-015, SC-007.
- [x] CHK036 - Are the requirements for narrow windows stated for the new parts that can grow (the list of 10 people, a long name in the field, the alert text)? [Coverage, Spec §SC-007] → Resolved in spec: FR-044.
- [x] CHK037 - Is auto-refresh while another person is shown, open and minimised, covered for the panel and for the launcher? [Coverage, Spec §US2 scenario 4, §US4 scenario 3] → Resolved in spec: FR-038, US2 scenario 14.

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK038 - Is it specified what happens when the selected person can no longer be read during the session (deactivated, or the user's permission removed)? [Edge Case, Gap] → Resolved in spec: Edge Cases.
- [x] CHK039 - Is the case of a user who may not look up people described so that the "not found" message is not misleading, or is one message for both cases intended? [Edge Case, Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases] → Resolved in spec: Edge Cases: one message is intended.
- [x] CHK040 - Are requirements defined for texts with special characters in the name field (quotation marks, percent signs, leading symbols)? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-017] → Resolved in spec: FR-017, Edge Cases.
- [x] CHK041 - Is the behaviour of two open Jira tabs specified for the remembered person (which tab's value wins)? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-035, Plan §Open points D6] → Resolved in spec: Edge Cases.
- [x] CHK042 - Is it specified what happens to a remembered person whose name changed in Jira since it was stored? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-036, §FR-008] → Resolved in spec: FR-036, Edge Cases.

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK043 - Are accessibility requirements stated for every new control (names and roles of the option group, the list, the busy "Zapisz", the alert), or only for the alert? [Coverage, Spec §FR-015, §FR-020, Constitution IV] → Resolved in spec: FR-043.
- [x] CHK044 - Are touch target sizes required for the new controls, in line with the 44 px rule of the constitution? [Gap, Constitution III] → Resolved in spec: FR-015.
- [x] CHK045 - Is it stated that keeping a colleague's name in the browser is acceptable where a browser profile is shared, and what the user can do to remove it? [Assumption, Gap, Spec §FR-035] → Resolved in spec: Assumptions, FR-035.
- [x] CHK046 - Is the number of requests a name check may send stated as a requirement, given that Jira's user search has a shared limit? [Gap, Plan §Technical Context] → Resolved in spec: FR-016, SC-008.
